## Interpretation boundaries

- Retrospective ranking, not prospective external validation.
- All five full-data refits reported; no checkpoint selected by case scores.
- Mean/SD over training seeds is not calibrated predictive uncertainty.
- Exact-sequence and k-mer exposure checks are not proof of no homologs.
- Docking geometry reused; new model-dependent occlusion/contact analysis recomputed.

Structure renderer: matplotlib_Calpha_fallback
Full outputs: predictions/, occlusion/, figures/, structure/.

## K4DD input syntax compatibility

The retained six-target panel contains 487 rows. Eighteen retained rows use the documented RDKit-compatible bracket-token spelling. The benchmark data under `data/` are unchanged, and no checkpoint was retrained.
